name: SpatialCam Lite-Capture 3D Stereo Video
summary:
SpatialCam Lite — Stereoscopic Camera for Meta Quest

SpatialCam Lite captures SBS stereoscopic photos and videos on Meta Quest 3/3S using Passthrough cameras. The app is free to download; advanced features require an optional in-app subscription purchased through the Meta Horizon Store.

Free plan (no subscription)
• Stereoscopic photo capture (SBS, 2560×960) — unlimited
• Stereoscopic video recording — up to 10 seconds per clip (recording stops automatically; the clip is still saved to your gallery)
